settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account, users, and system settings
settings.name: Name
settings.tenantLanguageDesc: Select tenant primary language. Bot auto-replies, issue report forms, and mobile SDK will automatically use this language.
settings.widgetBrandLogoDesc: Upload your company logo. It will be cropped to a square and displayed in the widget header.
settings.activeAiAgentDesc: Select which AI Agent (Flow) will reply to incoming messages from users.
settings.globalAiSystemPromptDesc: Global instructions for AI that apply to all agents in this tenant.
settings.humanHandoffTitle: Human Agent Support / Talk to CS
settings.humanHandoffDesc: Toggle to enable "Talk to Agent" option. Disable if live support is exclusively routed to official customer support email.
settings.defaultHandoffAgentDesc: Who will be assigned (or named by AI) when users are transferred to human agent queue.
settings.formFunnelSettings: Funnel Form & Issue Report Settings (When Agent is Disabled)
settings.formFunnelDesc: Configure inquiry and issue collection form (funnel) displayed to users when human agent option is disabled.
settings.defaultSupportEmailDesc: Official company email address that receives issue reports from users.
settings.buttonLabelHint: Example: Send Email to Company / Contact via Email
settings.issueCategoriesDesc: Category choices that will appear in user report funnel form.
settings.issueCategoriesPlaceholder: General Inquiry, Services & Facilities, Technical Issue, Billing & Payment, Partnership, Other
settings.autoReplyTemplateDesc: Automatic confirmation message after form submission. Supported tags:
settings.autoReplyPlaceholder: Thank you {name}! Your message and report regarding {category} has been forwarded to our team. We will follow up via email ({email}) shortly.
settings.inAppFormToggleDesc: If enabled, users fill category and description directly inside widget/SDK. If disabled, clicking button opens email client (mailto).
settings.emailSmtpServiceDesc: Configure email delivery gateway for visitor inquiry/issue report notifications from mobile app and chat widget to company's official email (tenant).
settings.azureDesc: Office 365 OAuth2 Client Credentials. More secure without legacy SMTP ports.
settings.gmailDesc: Use Gmail / Google Workspace account with App Password.
settings.customDesc: Connect to Mailgun, SendGrid, Amazon SES, or custom SMTP server.
settings.azureConfigDesc: Using Azure App Registration credentials (OAuth2 Client Credentials Flow).
settings.subjectPrefixHint: Will appear as prefix in email subject: [UAT-APP] Email Subject
settings.gmailSecurityWarning: Google Security Note: Use a 16-character Google App Password created in Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification > App Passwords. Do not use your regular login password.
settings.customSmtpDesc: Supports standard SMTP servers with port 587 (TLS/STARTTLS) or 465 (SSL).
settings.recipientSupportEmailDesc: Whenever visitors in widget or mobile app submit issue report forms (when human handoff is routed), system sends summary emails to this address using the provider above.
settings.emailDeliveryTestDesc: Send a test email now to verify your credentials are valid and can deliver to inbox.
settings.invalidTestEmail: Please enter a valid test recipient email address.
settings.testEmailFailed: Failed to send test email. Please check your credentials.

integration.title: Website Integration
integration.subtitle: Connect your AI Agent to your website or platform using the snippets below.
integration.tenantIdDesc: This is your unique Tenant ID. You may need it for API integrations, webhooks, or configuring your AI Agent proxy.
integration.htmlDesc: Paste this snippet right before the closing </body> tag on all pages where you want the widget to appear.
integration.wpDesc: If you are using WordPress, create a file named saas-crm-agent.php in your wp-content/plugins/ directory and paste the code below. Then, activate the plugin from your WordPress Admin dashboard.

homepage.heroDesc: This is a simulated view of your website. The smart chat widget has been installed in the corner of the screen and is ready to use.
homepage.copyCodeDesc: To activate this widget on your website, copy the snippet code below and paste it right before the closing </body> tag in your HTML.

visitors.title: Visitors & Leads

visitors.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or phone...
visitors.configSubtitle: Manage automatic data collection and lead intelligence settings.
visitors.enableTrackingDesc: If disabled, no visitor data will be tracked
visitors.enablePassiveDesc: Collect device, OS, browser info, and referrer source in the background.
visitors.enableGeoDesc: Request permission to collect visitor location (lat/lng).
visitors.enableNlpDesc: AI will automatically detect and save name, email, or phone mentioned in chat.
visitors.enableClassificationDesc: AI will classify user intent on every turn (e.g., Hot Lead, Support).
visitors.enableLeadFormDesc: Show a lead form if a specific classification is detected.
